sahneler.metin: An explosion tore through two connected coal mines in West Virginia.
It killed at least three hundred sixty two miners.
It remains America's deadliest mining disaster.
The two mines were linked underground.
Coal dust carried the explosion through both.
The true toll is probably higher.
Many helpers underground were never recorded.
It helped lead to the creation of the US Bureau of Mines.
